title: Shield of Shielding
summary: +2 AC, Shield Bash and a once-per-Long-Rest Shield reaction.

fields.Shield Bash: When hit by a melee attack, spend a Reaction. The attacker makes a Strength save against your spell save DC or falls Prone for 1 turn. The tooltip instead names Dexterity.
fields.Shield spell: Level 1 Reaction once per Long Rest when hit. +5 AC until your next turn and immunity to Magic Missile.
fields.Acquisition: Offerings to Helm chest below Stormshore Tabernacle. Looting curses the character with Castigated by Divinity.
